name: reading-layout
title: Reading Layout
description: A long read with its table of contents: the text column, and beside it a `Toc` rail that stays in view as the reader scrolls. When the layout is too narrow for a rail, the contents fold into a slim bar (`TocBar`) that sticks to the top of the column, names…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/reading-layout

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/reading-layout.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/reading-layout';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/reading-layout

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
